Players Committee card image of [[Why Does Everyone Want To Go Back To Jakku?!]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. May deploy Lor San Tekka from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per turn, if you just lost a Resistance character from a Jakku site, may take a Resistance character of lesser ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/whydoeseveryonewanttogobacktojakku.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
